title: lathyrus lanszwertii var. sandbergii
intro: Lathyrus lanszwertii var. sandbergii, commonly known as Sandberg's pea or Sandberg's lathyrus, is a perennial legume native to the Pacific Northwest region of North America. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its potential to alleviate gastrointestinal issues and reduce inflammation. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Lathyrus lanszwertii var. sandbergii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
